description: Read many prompts at once, such as a team's shared prompt doc: each prompt's score on the ten checks, the task it does and how ready it is for it, near-copies with the one to keep, private details that should not be in a shared prompt (emails, phone numbers, card numbers, keys), which collections the library covers and the expert prompts it lacks, a health score, and which prompts to fix first.

text.description: Or many prompts in one text, separated by lines of three dashes.

name: audit_library

clusters.description: Near-copies, with the one to keep.

fix_first.description: What to fix first, weakest on the tasks used most.

gaps.description: Expert prompts in the library's own collections that it does not have.

prompts.description: Every prompt: score, readiness, task, what it misses, private details, which it copies.

title: Audit a whole prompt library
